cases.name: no database: download
logs: waiting for the advisory database lock in <cache>/cache
downloading the advisory database into volume jspf-cache-osv-db
downloaded the advisory database
calls:
set -e
test -n "$(find /osv-db/staging -name all.zip -size +100k | head -n 1)"
rm -rf /osv-db/previous
if [ -d /osv-db/current ]; then mv /osv-db/current /osv-db/previous; fi
mv /osv-db/staging /osv-db/current
printf %s "$JSPF_DB_DATE" > /osv-db/updated-at.tmp
mv /osv-db/updated-at.tmp /osv-db/updated-at
rm -rf /osv-db/previous
